name: Propstack
description: Propstack — the CRM German estate agents run on: properties, contacts, enquiries, activities, projects and saved searches. REST API v1, API-key auth.
instructions:
**Getting a key**
1. Sign in to Propstack as an administrator and open **Verwaltung → API-Schlüssel** (crm.propstack.de/app/admin/api_keys).
2. Create an **API V1** key, give it the read permissions the agent needs, and put it in `PROPSTACK_API_KEY`. The key carries the permissions set there — treat it as a password, because whoever holds it can read the whole customer base.

**The key travels in an `X-API-KEY` header.** No Bearer. (Propstack also accepts an `api_key` query parameter; this adapter does not use it, so the key stays out of URLs and logs.)

**Properties are the centre of this API.** Propstack's API calls a listing a *unit* (`/v1/units`, Objekte in the UI) — flat, house, commercial unit — carrying its address, price, area, room count, marketing type (`BUY` or `RENT`) and status. `propstack_list_properties` filters by those (`status` takes the account's own status ids, `q` is a full-text search); `propstack_get_property` returns the full record with images and documents.

**Contacts and enquiries are separate.** A *contact* is a person; an *enquiry* (Anfrage) is that person asking about a specific property, stored by Propstack as an activity of type enquiry. A question about interest in a listing wants enquiries, not contacts.

**Expand what you need.** Many list responses return related objects only as ids. Pass `expand=1` where the tool offers it to get readable nested objects instead of a second round of calls.

**Paging** is `page` (1-based) and `per` (default 20; stay at or below 500 to avoid timeouts). Listings and contacts are requested with `with_meta=1` and activities carry it anyway, so those responses report the total in `meta.total_count`. Projects and brokers are returned in one list without paging.

**Checked against the docs, not a live account.** Paths and parameters follow docs.propstack.de (API v1), and every path answers on api.propstack.de, but no call has been made with a real key. An unknown path makes Propstack redirect to its web app instead of returning a 404.

**Cloud reachability**: api.propstack.de is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: propstack_list_properties
tools.description: List property listings (Propstack calls them units/Objekte) with their address, price, living area, room count, marketing type and status. The main query for 'what do we have on the market'.

per.description: Rows per page (default 20; keep it at 500 or below to avoid timeouts).

status.description: Status id the listing must be in; several ids comma-separated. Status ids are account-specific (Propstack: Objekt-Stati).

marketing_type.description: `BUY` for sale listings or `RENT` for rentals.

q.description: Full-text search over unit_id, street, zip_code, city, district and exposee_id.

project_id.description: Only the units of one project.

expand.description: Pass 1 for the detailed JSON, custom fields included.

tools.name: propstack_get_property
tools.description: Read one property listing in full: full address, all price and area fields, the description texts, images, documents and the assigned broker.

tools.name: propstack_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts — buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants — with their name, e-mail, phone and the client source they came from.

q.description: Search term matched against first name, last name, e-mails, address and phone numbers.

tools.name: propstack_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact in full: contact details, search profile, the properties they are linked to and their consent flags.

tools.name: propstack_list_enquiries
tools.description: List enquiries (Anfragen) — a person asking about a specific listing. Propstack stores them as activities of type enquiry; each row carries its date, source and the linked contact and property.

property_id.description: Restrict to enquiries about one property.

tools.name: propstack_list_activities
tools.description: List activities — calls, viewings, e-mails and notes logged against a contact or a property. The interaction history a broker actually needs.

client_id.description: Restrict to activities on one contact.

property_id.description: Restrict to activities on one property.

tools.name: propstack_list_projects
tools.description: List projects — the developments several units belong to — with their name, address and the number of units in each.

tools.name: propstack_list_brokers
tools.description: List the brokers (users) in the account with their name, e-mail and the office they belong to, to resolve who owns a listing or a contact.
